title: BUGFIX — pipeline-cron.ts: increase multiformat pipeline timeout from 5min to 10min
description: Multiformat pipeline (TTS + avatar generation + FFmpeg composition per video) consistently times out at 5min (300000ms) with 3 videos. TTS + Captions.ai API calls alone take 2-3min per video. Increase timeout to 10min (600000ms) to prevent false failure alerts and missing videos.

tasks.title: Increase multiformat pipeline timeout 300000 → 600000 in pipeline-cron.ts
